annotation.evidence_span: MAY then make its own decision regarding whether or not to redirect the request.
annotation.interpretation_a: The user agent is permitted to follow the redirection and retry the PUT request to the new URI.
annotation.interpretation_b: The user agent is permitted to ignore the redirection and treat the PUT request as a failure, potentially returning an error to the application.
annotation.justification: The clause states the user agent 'MAY' redirect. This allows for two reasonable interpretations: the user agent can choose to follow the redirection, or it can choose not to. A missing constraint would specify whether the user agent *must* follow the redirection in this scenario, or if it has the discretion to handle the redirection as an error.
